To get the size of a data type
To get the size of a pointer
To get the size of an array
items.explain: The sizeof operator returns the size of a variable or data type

items.q: What is the difference between a struct and a class in C?
opts: A struct is a value type, while a class is a reference type
A struct is a reference type, while a class is a value type
A struct is used for data, while a class is used for functions
items.explain: C does not have classes, but it has structs which are used to define custom data types
